snippet.title: Galaxy Unwritten - Official Gameplay Trailer | Fight. Trade. Build.
snippet.description:
Explore, fight, trade and build your own future in Galaxy Unwritten, a single-player space sandbox.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5489350/Galaxy_Unwritten/

Pilot your own ship. Build a fleet. Earn your place among the stars.

Watch the official gameplay trailer from Exopoint Initiative. Explore a procedurally generated galaxy and make your living as a trader, miner, salvager or mercenary — or take what you are owed as a pirate.

CHOOSE YOUR WAY FORWARD

• Fight in real-time space battles, break enemy shields and keep flying as damage scars your hull.
• Mine asteroids, deploy mining drones and recover valuable equipment from wrecks.
• Trade between stations and build modular factories connected by production and supply chains.
• Recruit captains and crew, develop their skills and command a fleet beyond the ship you pilot.
• Customize your loadout with rare ship modules and shape your character through an extensive passive skill tree.
• Board enemy ships and bases in tactical boarding battles involving thousands of combatants.
• Found your own faction, claim sectors and manage the territory and resources behind your expansion.
• Create local mods with built-in visual tools for supported ships, station modules and equipment.

A living economy connects the galaxy. Ships need materials, factories need supplies, and the trade routes you protect — or disrupt — can change what a faction is able to build.

Your freedom. Your choices. Your place among the stars.

EXPLORE THE GAME
https://galaxyunwritten.com/en/

JOIN OUR DISCORD
https://discord.gg/8xXQmaeQbu

Developed and published by Exopoint Initiative.
Business and press enquiries: contact@galaxyunwritten.com

Development footage. Features, visuals and balance may change.

Subscribe for gameplay, development updates and new trailers.
